trigger: Applying the evidence helper during a small read-only acceptance audit
observation: An independent forward evaluator needed byte-identical snapshots and hash bookkeeping because helper records must live under its project root while audit writes were forbidden in the target tree.
wrong_decision: Presented repeatable helper use without an explicit proportional read-only alternative
correction: Allow native test logs, a compact requirement matrix and input fingerprint in the authorized output directory; keep the helper optional when it adds no useful evidence
scope: This candidate workflow and small read-only audits with restricted output paths
counterexample: A writable adopted business project with recurring acceptance checks benefits from persistent helper evidence
